notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Accomplished Alchemist.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Accomplished Alchemist.
Repeat.
